name: my-provider
label: Any email-by-domain API you have a key for
about: Copy this file to enrich-providers/my-provider.json, rename it, and fill it in from your provider's API documentation. {domain} and {company} are replaced with the lead's domain and name. Your key is never written here: put it in a Windows user variable (setx NAME value) and write only the variable's NAME below.
credits: Say here what one call costs, so the next person knows.
